local function buildChairModel(skinId: string): Model
	local info = CHAIR_DATA[skinId] or CHAIR_DATA.wood
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Chair_" .. skinId

	local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cf
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	local function makeCylinder(name: string, length: number, radius: number, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		p.Size = Vector3.new(length, radius * 2, radius * 2)
		p.CFrame = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	local function makeSphere(name: string, diameter: number, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?): Part
		local p = makePart(name, Vector3.new(diameter, diameter, diameter), cf, color, mat)
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		return p
	end

	if skinId == "stadium" then
		-- Lego Stadium Chair matching orthographic reference sheet (pedestal, 2x2 stud base, ribbed backrest)
		local blueMain = Color3.fromHex("#1E6FFF")
		local blueShadow = Color3.fromHex("#1555C5")
		local blueRib = Color3.fromHex("#2879FF")
		local darkBase = Color3.fromHex("#242C38")
		local darkStud = Color3.fromHex("#2B3442")

		makePart("BasePlate", Vector3.new(1.40, 0.28, 1.40), CFrame.new(0, 0.24, -0.05), darkBase)
		local sDist = 0.38
		makeCylinder("Stud_FL", 0.12, 0.17, CFrame.new(-sDist, 0.44, -0.05 + sDist), darkStud)
		makeCylinder("Stud_FR", 0.12, 0.17, CFrame.new( sDist, 0.44, -0.05 + sDist), darkStud)
		makeCylinder("Stud_BL", 0.12, 0.17, CFrame.new(-sDist, 0.44, -0.05 - sDist), darkStud)
		makeCylinder("Stud_BR", 0.12, 0.17, CFrame.new( sDist, 0.44, -0.05 - sDist), darkStud)
		makePart("CenterPost", Vector3.new(0.48, 0.48, 0.48), CFrame.new(0, 0.62, -0.05), darkBase)
		makePart("SeatBase", Vector3.new(1.62, 0.18, 1.60), CFrame.new(0, 0.95, -0.05), blueMain)
		local seatCushion = makePart("SeatCushion", Vector3.new(1.58, 0.22, 1.15), CFrame.new(0, 1.15, 0.18), blueMain)
		model.PrimaryPart = seatCushion

		local backTiltAngle = math.rad(-8.5)
		local backrestCF = CFrame.new(0, 1.82, -0.42) * CFrame.Angles(backTiltAngle, 0, 0)
		makePart("BackrestSlab", Vector3.new(1.62, 1.52, 0.26), backrestCF, blueMain)
		makePart("RibBacking", Vector3.new(1.36, 1.30, 0.02), backrestCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.13), blueShadow)
		makePart("RibLeft", Vector3.new(0.32, 1.26, 0.06), backrestCF * CFrame.new(-0.36, 0, 0.16), blueRib)
		makePart("RibRight", Vector3.new(0.32, 1.26, 0.06), backrestCF * CFrame.new(0.36, 0, 0.16), blueRib)

		makePart("BackRimTop", Vector3.new(1.62, 0.12, 0.04), backrestCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.70, -0.15), blueMain)
		makePart("BackRimBottom", Vector3.new(1.62, 0.12, 0.04), backrestCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.70, -0.15), blueMain)
		makePart("BackRimLeft", Vector3.new(0.12, 1.28, 0.04), backrestCF * CFrame.new(-0.75, 0, -0.15), blueMain)
		makePart("BackRimRight", Vector3.new(0.12, 1.28, 0.04), backrestCF * CFrame.new(0.75, 0, -0.15), blueMain)
		makePart("BackRecess", Vector3.new(1.38, 1.28, 0.02), backrestCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.13), blueShadow)
		return model
	end

	if skinId == "cyber_core" then
		local cMetal = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 32)
		local cCap = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 60)
		local cCyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 240)
		local cMagenta = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 200)

		local seatPart = makePart("Seat", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.28, 1.6), CFrame.new(0, 1.14, 0), cMetal, Enum.Material.Metal)
		model.PrimaryPart = seatPart

		-- Glowing circuit traces on seat
		makePart("SeatCircuitX1", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.04, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 1.29, -0.72), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("SeatCircuitX2", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.04, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 1.29,  0.72), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("SeatCircuitZ1", Vector3.new(0.06, 0.04, 1.4), CFrame.new(-0.72, 1.29, 0), cMagenta, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("SeatCircuitZ2", Vector3.new(0.06, 0.04, 1.4), CFrame.new( 0.72, 1.29, 0), cMagenta, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("SeatChipCenter", Vector3.new(0.48, 0.03, 0.48), CFrame.new(0, 1.29, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)

		-- 4 Legs & Caps
		local legOffsets = {
			FL = Vector3.new(-0.64, 0.50, -0.64),
			FR = Vector3.new( 0.64, 0.50, -0.64),
			BL = Vector3.new(-0.64, 0.50,  0.64),
			BR = Vector3.new( 0.64, 0.50,  0.64),
		}
		for tag, offset in legOffsets do
			makePart("Leg_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.32, 1.0, 0.32), CFrame.new(offset), cMetal, Enum.Material.Metal)
			makePart("LegTrace_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.05, 0.95, 0.05), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.50, offset.Z - 0.15), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)
			makePart("LegCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.38, 0.20, 0.38), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.10, offset.Z), cCap, Enum.Material.Metal)
			makePart("Gem_LegCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.03), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.10, offset.Z - 0.20) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cMagenta, Enum.Material.Neon)
		end

		-- Backrest Posts & Caps
		makePart("Post_Left", Vector3.new(0.32, 2.0, 0.32), CFrame.new(-0.64, 2.28, 0.64), cMetal, Enum.Material.Metal)
		makePart("Post_Right", Vector3.new(0.32, 2.0, 0.32), CFrame.new( 0.64, 2.28, 0.64), cMetal, Enum.Material.Metal)
		makePart("PostTrace_Left", Vector3.new(0.05, 1.9, 0.05), CFrame.new(-0.64, 2.28, 0.47), cMagenta, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("PostTrace_Right", Vector3.new(0.05, 1.9, 0.05), CFrame.new( 0.64, 2.28, 0.47), cMagenta, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("PostCap_Left", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.20, 0.38), CFrame.new(-0.64, 3.28, 0.64), cCap, Enum.Material.Metal)
		makePart("PostCap_Right", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.20, 0.38), CFrame.new( 0.64, 3.28, 0.64), cCap, Enum.Material.Metal)
		makePart("Gem_PostCap_L_Front", Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.03), CFrame.new(-0.64, 3.28, 0.44) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("Gem_PostCap_R_Front", Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.03), CFrame.new( 0.64, 3.28, 0.44) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)

		-- Backrest Panel & Hex Frame
		makePart("BackrestPanel", Vector3.new(1.28, 1.40, 0.16), CFrame.new(0, 2.14, 0.64), cMetal, Enum.Material.Metal)

		local hexR = 0.34
		for i = 0, 5 do
			local rad = math.rad(i * 60)
			local hx = math.cos(rad) * hexR
			local hy = math.sin(rad) * hexR
			makePart("HexStrut_" .. i, Vector3.new(0.18, 0.04, 0.05), CFrame.new(hx, 2.14 + hy, 0.54) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad + math.rad(30)), cMagenta, Enum.Material.Neon)
		end

		-- Energy Core (floating rotating gem)
		makePart("EnergyCore", Vector3.new(0.32, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(0, 2.14, 0.54) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), math.rad(45), 0), cCyan, Enum.Material.Neon)

		return model
	end

	if skinId == "golden" or skinId == "football_throne" then
		local cGold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 30)
		local cVelvet = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 32)
		local cDark = Color3.fromRGB(30, 24, 22)
		local cRuby = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 50)
		local cWhite = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local cBlack = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 22)

		-- 1. Base Foot Slabs, Pillars & Red Inset Panels
		for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
			local bx = if tag == "Left" then -0.62 else 0.62
			makePart("FootSlab_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.48, 0.18, 1.2), CFrame.new(bx, 0.09, 0), cGold)
			makePart("Pillar_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.40, 0.62, 0.90), CFrame.new(bx, 0.49, 0), cGold)
			makePart("PillarPanel_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.28, 0.46, 0.04), CFrame.new(bx, 0.49, -0.46), cVelvet)
		end
		makePart("UndersideHollow", Vector3.new(0.72, 0.54, 0.90), CFrame.new(0, 0.45, 0), cDark)

		-- 2. Seat Frame & Red Quilted Cushion (Seat)
		makePart("SeatFrame", Vector3.new(1.65, 0.22, 1.25), CFrame.new(0, 0.88, 0), cGold)
		local seatCushion = makePart("SeatCushion", Vector3.new(1.48, 0.28, 1.10), CFrame.new(0, 1.08, 0.04), cVelvet)
		model.PrimaryPart = seatCushion

		makePart("FrontDiamondFrame", Vector3.new(0.46, 0.46, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 0.88, -0.63) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGold)
		makePart("FrontRubyGem", Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 0.08), CFrame.new(0, 0.88, -0.66) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cRuby, Enum.Material.Neon)

		-- 3. Chunky Armrests with Inset Panels & Gold Diamond
		for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
			local ax = if tag == "Left" then -0.76 else 0.76
			makePart("Armrest_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.38, 0.45, 1.15), CFrame.new(ax, 1.34, 0), cGold)
			makePart("ArmrestPanel_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.26, 0.32, 0.04), CFrame.new(ax, 1.34, -0.58), cVelvet)
			makePart("ArmrestGem_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.12, 0.04), CFrame.new(ax, 1.34, -0.60) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGold)
		end

		-- 4. Backrest Outer Frame & Wing-Spikes
		makePart("BackrestFrame", Vector3.new(1.68, 1.95, 0.28), CFrame.new(0, 2.05, 0.52), cGold)
		makePart("WingSpike_Left", Vector3.new(0.40, 0.65, 0.22), CFrame.new(-0.95, 2.95, 0.52) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(35)), cGold)
		makePart("WingSpike_Right", Vector3.new(0.40, 0.65, 0.22), CFrame.new( 0.95, 2.95, 0.52) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-35)), cGold)

		-- 5. Inner Red Quilted Panel & Tuft Buttons
		makePart("QuiltedPanel", Vector3.new(1.22, 1.48, 0.18), CFrame.new(0, 1.92, 0.42), cVelvet)
		for row = 0, 2 do
			for col = 0, 2 do
				local bx = (col - 1) * 0.36
				local by = 1.55 + row * 0.37
				makeSphere("TuftButton_" .. row .. "_" .. col, 0.11, CFrame.new(bx, by, 0.32), cGold)
			end
		end

		-- 6. Soccer Ball & Gold Emblem Ring
		makePart("EmblemRing", Vector3.new(0.92, 0.92, 0.14), CFrame.new(0, 2.58, 0.40) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGold)
		makeSphere("SoccerBall", 0.68, CFrame.new(0, 2.58, 0.38), cWhite)
		makePart("SoccerPentagon", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.04), CFrame.new(0, 2.58, 0.04) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(36)), cBlack)

		-- 7. 5-Peak Crown with Ruby Gem
		local crownPeaks = {
			{ -0.42, 0.30, -18 },
			{ -0.21, 0.45,  -9 },
			{  0.00, 0.60,   0 },
			{  0.21, 0.45,   9 },
			{  0.42, 0.30,  18 },
		}
		for idx, cfg in ipairs(crownPeaks) do
			local px, ph, prot = cfg[1], cfg[2], cfg[3]
			makePart("CrownPeak_" .. idx, Vector3.new(0.18, ph, 0.15), CFrame.new(px, 3.12 + ph * 0.38, 0.42) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(prot)), cGold)
		end
		makePart("CrownRubyGem", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.08), CFrame.new(0, 3.38, 0.33) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cRuby, Enum.Material.Neon)

		-- 8. Side Banners
		makePart("Banner_Left", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.75, 0.04), CFrame.new(-0.96, 2.12, 0.44), cVelvet)
		makePart("Banner_Right", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.75, 0.04), CFrame.new( 0.96, 2.12, 0.44), cVelvet)
		makePart("BannerCrown_L", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.10, 0.02), CFrame.new(-0.96, 2.26, 0.42), cGold, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("BannerCrown_R", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.10, 0.02), CFrame.new( 0.96, 2.26, 0.42), cGold, Enum.Material.Neon)

		return model
	end

	-- Base Geometry: Seat, Backrest, Rounded Top Cap
	makePart("Seat", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.28, 1.5), CFrame.new(0, 0.8, 0), info.color, info.mat)
	makePart("Back", Vector3.new(1.6, 1.45, 0.28), CFrame.new(0, 1.62, -0.62), info.color, info.mat)
	makeCylinder("TopCap", 1.6, 0.14, CFrame.new(0, 2.34, -0.62), info.color, info.mat)

	-- 4 Legs
	for _, lx in { -0.60, 0.60 } do
		for _, lz in { -0.55, 0.55 } do
			makePart("Leg", Vector3.new(0.20, 0.8, 0.20), CFrame.new(lx, 0.4, lz), info.legColor, info.mat)
		end
	end

	-- Skin-specific 3D features
	if skinId == "wood" then
		local grooveCol = Color3.fromRGB(75, 42, 24)
		makePart("Slat1", Vector3.new(0.04, 1.35, 0.02), CFrame.new(-0.27, 1.62, -0.47), grooveCol, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
		makePart("Slat2", Vector3.new(0.04, 1.35, 0.02), CFrame.new(0.27, 1.62, -0.47), grooveCol, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
		makePart("SlatH", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.04, 0.02), CFrame.new(0, 1.62, -0.47), grooveCol, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)


	elseif skinId == "crimson" or skinId == "emerald" then
		local cWood = Color3.fromRGB(150, 15, 25)
		local cLeg = Color3.fromRGB(110, 10, 20)
		local cIron = Color3.fromRGB(30, 24, 28)
		local cGem = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 50)
		local cEmblem = Color3.fromRGB(40, 10, 15)

		-- 4 Legs & Dark Iron Caps with Gems
		local legOffsets = {
			FL = Vector3.new(-0.64, 0.50, -0.64),
			FR = Vector3.new( 0.64, 0.50, -0.64),
			BL = Vector3.new(-0.64, 0.50,  0.64),
			BR = Vector3.new( 0.64, 0.50,  0.64),
		}
		for tag, offset in legOffsets do
			makePart("Leg_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.32, 1.0, 0.32), CFrame.new(offset), cLeg, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
			makePart("LegCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.38, 0.20, 0.38), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.10, offset.Z), cIron, Enum.Material.Slate)
			makePart("Gem_LegCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.03), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.10, offset.Z - 0.20) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGem, Enum.Material.Neon)
		end

		-- Backrest Posts & Caps with Gems
		makePart("Post_Left", Vector3.new(0.32, 2.0, 0.32), CFrame.new(-0.64, 2.28, 0.64), cWood, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
		makePart("Post_Right", Vector3.new(0.32, 2.0, 0.32), CFrame.new( 0.64, 2.28, 0.64), cWood, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
		makePart("PostCap_Left", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.20, 0.38), CFrame.new(-0.64, 3.28, 0.64), cIron, Enum.Material.Slate)
		makePart("PostCap_Right", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.20, 0.38), CFrame.new( 0.64, 3.28, 0.64), cIron, Enum.Material.Slate)
		makePart("Gem_PostCap_L", Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.03), CFrame.new(-0.64, 3.28, 0.44) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGem, Enum.Material.Neon)
		makePart("Gem_PostCap_R", Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.03), CFrame.new( 0.64, 3.28, 0.44) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGem, Enum.Material.Neon)

		-- Backrest Panel with Flame Emblem
		local backrest = makePart("BackrestPanel", Vector3.new(1.28, 1.40, 0.16), CFrame.new(0, 2.14, 0.64), cWood, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
		local backEmblem = Instance.new("Decal")
		backEmblem.Name = "FlameEmblem_Backrest"
		backEmblem.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		backEmblem.Texture = "rbxassetid://90165853329906"
		backEmblem.Color3 = cEmblem
		backEmblem.Transparency = 0.2
		backEmblem.Parent = backrest

		-- Seat Corner Brackets & Gems
		for tag, d in { FL = { -1, -1 }, FR = { 1, -1 }, BL = { -1, 1 }, BR = { 1, 1 } } do
			local cx, cz = d[1], d[2]
			makePart("CornerBracket_X_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.34, 0.05, 0.11), CFrame.new(cx * (0.8 - 0.17), 1.05, cz * (0.8 - 0.055)), cIron, Enum.Material.Slate)
			makePart("CornerBracket_Z_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.11, 0.05, 0.34), CFrame.new(cx * (0.8 - 0.055), 1.05, cz * (0.8 - 0.17)), cIron, Enum.Material.Slate)
			makePart("Gem_Corner_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.10, 0.10, 0.04), CFrame.new(cx * 0.72, 1.08, cz * 0.72) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0), cGem, Enum.Material.Neon)
		end
	elseif skinId == "frostbite" or skinId == "cyber" then
		local cDeep = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 230)
		local cMain = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255)
		local cGlow = Color3.fromRGB(160, 240, 255)
		local cSnow = Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 255)
		local cGem = Color3.fromRGB(100, 235, 255)

		-- Seat Cushion Recess
		makePart("SeatRecess", Vector3.new(1.3, 0.08, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 0.96, 0.05), cMain, Enum.Material.Glass)

		-- 3 Front Chevron Plates
		for i = 0, 2 do
			local yOff = 0.88 - (i * 0.18)
			makePart("Chevron_L_" .. i, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.10, 0.06), CFrame.new(-0.22, yOff, 0.76) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-22)), cGlow, Enum.Material.Neon)
			makePart("Chevron_R_" .. i, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.10, 0.06), CFrame.new( 0.22, yOff, 0.76) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad( 22)), cGlow, Enum.Material.Neon)
		end

		-- 4 Chipped Foot Blocks
		for _, lx in { -0.60, 0.60 } do
			for _, lz in { -0.55, 0.55 } do
				makePart("FootBlock", Vector3.new(0.36, 0.22, 0.36), CFrame.new(lx, 0.11, lz), cMain, Enum.Material.Glass)
			end
		end

		-- 2 Armrests with Snow Caps & Icicles
		for _, ax in { -0.80, 0.80 } do
			makePart("Armrest", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.24, 1.25), CFrame.new(ax, 1.15, 0), cDeep, Enum.Material.Glass)
			makePart("SnowCap", Vector3.new(0.28, 0.08, 1.25), CFrame.new(ax, 1.30, 0), cSnow, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
			for ic = 0, 2 do
				makePart("Icicle", Vector3.new(0.04, 0.20, 0.04), CFrame.new(ax, 0.95 - ic * 0.03, -0.4 + ic * 0.4), cGlow, Enum.Material.Glass)
			end
		end

		-- 5 Backrest Chevrons
		for i = 0, 4 do
			local yOff = 1.15 + (i * 0.24)
			local w = 0.55 - (i * 0.06)
			makePart("BackChevron_L_" .. i, Vector3.new(w, 0.08, 0.04), CFrame.new(-w * 0.45, yOff, -0.47) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-26)), cMain, Enum.Material.Glass)
			makePart("BackChevron_R_" .. i, Vector3.new(w, 0.08, 0.04), CFrame.new( w * 0.45, yOff, -0.47) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad( 26)), cMain, Enum.Material.Glass)
		end

		-- Crown Fan of 7 Crystal Shards
		local shards = {
			{ -0.65, 1.2, -28, 0.14 },
			{ -0.42, 1.6, -18, 0.16 },
			{ -0.20, 1.9,  -8, 0.18 },
			{  0.00, 2.1,   0, 0.20 }, -- Center
			{  0.20, 1.9,   8, 0.18 },
			{  0.42, 1.6,  18, 0.16 },
			{  0.65, 1.2,  28, 0.14 },
		}
		for idx, cfg in ipairs(shards) do
			local sx, sh, srot, sw = cfg[1], cfg[2], cfg[3], cfg[4]
			makePart("Shard_" .. idx, Vector3.new(sw, sh, sw), CFrame.new(sx, 1.8 + sh * 0.4, -0.62) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(srot)), cGlow, Enum.Material.Neon)
		end

		-- Center Top Diamond Crystal Gem
		makePart("TopGem", Vector3.new(0.36, 0.52, 0.22), CFrame.new(0, 2.95, -0.58) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), cGem, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	return model
end

local function buildChairModel(skinId: string): Model
	return ChairModelBuilder.buildChair(skinId)
end

local function createChairViewport(skinId: string, parent: GuiObject): ViewportFrame
	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Name = "ChairVP_" .. skinId
	vp.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.50, 0)
	vp.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.19, 0)
	vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
	vp.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 2
	vp.Active = true
	vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
	vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.35, -0.60, 0.72)

	local model = ChairModelBuilder.buildChair(skinId)
	model.Parent = vp

	-- Center model at 0, 0, 0
	local bbCF, bbSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local center = bbCF.Position
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() - center)

	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 24
	local maxDim = math.max(bbSize.X, bbSize.Y, bbSize.Z)
	local dist = (maxDim / 2) / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.18
	local camDir = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.40, 1.25).Unit
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camDir * dist, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam

	-- Interactive turntable rotation (cursor drag + hold, mobile touch drag + hold)
	local angle = 0
	local isHeld = false
	local isHovered = false
	local lastX: number? = nil

	vp.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isHeld = true
			lastX = input.Position.X
		end
	end)

	vp.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isHeld = false
			lastX = nil
		end
	end)

	vp.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if isHeld and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			if lastX then
				local deltaX = input.Position.X - lastX
				angle += deltaX * 0.015
				lastX = input.Position.X
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0))
			end
		end
	end)

	vp.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		isHovered = true
	end)

	vp.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		isHovered = false
		isHeld = false
		lastX = nil
	end)

	local stepConn: RBXScriptConnection?
	stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not vp:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
		if isHeld then
			angle += 2.0 * dt
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0))
		elseif isHovered then
			angle += 0.8 * dt
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0))
		end
	end)

	vp.Destroying:Connect(function()
		if stepConn then
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			stepConn = nil
		end
	end)

	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp
end
